questions.stem: A stretched elastic band has energy in which store?
questions.explanation: A stretched elastic band stores energy in the elastic potential energy store. This energy is released when the band returns to its original shape.

questions.stem: Which of the following is an energy transfer pathway, NOT an energy store?
questions.explanation: Radiation is an energy transfer pathway (how energy moves between stores), not an energy store. The four main transfer pathways are mechanical work, electrical work, heating, and radiation.
